name: Smart Materials and Structures
description: Introduction to smart material systems; overview of smart materials; modeling mechanical, thermal and electrical systems (thermomechanics and electrostatics); piezoelectric materials: constitutive modelling, static and vibration analysis; shape memory alloys (SMA): constitutive modelling, actuation models for SMA; brief overview of electroactive polymers, magnetostrictive materials, electro- and magneto-rheological fluids; mechanics of smart composite structures; transducer applications and case studies.
